name: Pocket Locksmith
description: Orbit a translucent three-dimensional binding pocket and turn the partially occluded joints of one connected key until the marked contacts fit without collisions.
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Orbit the pocket and rotate the connected key until every marked contact region is occupied while the key clears the pocket walls. Then certify the fit. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, or page-state inspection; the terminal, shell, Python, address bar, URL or query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.notes: Original articulated-key analogue of the surveyed Tweak Ligand interaction: camera access reveals curved handles, a torsion moves every downstream atom, and the independent replay checks fixed connectivity, contacts, bounds, and clashes. The browser never receives the target torsions.
